title: Duplicated "eligible servers" query in index() and connect()
comment: The exact same query - Server::isReachable()->get()->filter(fn (Server $server) => $server->isTerminalEnabled())->values() - is repeated verbatim in index() (line 22) and connect() (line 46). If the eligibility rule for terminal access ever changes, it's easy to update one call site and miss the other, silently diverging what a user sees in the dropdown from what connect() actually allows.
additional: Extract into a shared private method, e.g. eligibleServers(): Collection, and call it from both places.

title: kong case mislabeled "Supabase" and missing break - falls through into minio
comment: The switch case for $image->contains('kong') builds dashboard user/password fields but calls $fields->put('Supabase', ...) instead of $fields->put('Kong', ...) - a real, user-facing mislabel in the one-click service extra-fields UI. Worse, there's no break; after that put() call, so PHP's switch falls through unconditionally into the next case ($image->contains('minio')), running MinIO's entire field-resolution block for a Kong-image service too - producing a spurious, mostly-empty 'MinIO' field group alongside the mislabeled 'Supabase' one.
additional: Rename the field group to 'Kong' and add a break; statement after the put() call, matching every other case in this switch.
